items.title: 騰訊Q2廣告收入升22%
items.title_en: Tencent Q2 2026: AI-Driven Ad Revenue Surges 22% YoY
items.summary: 騰訊Q2廣告收入逾433億元，同比升22%，AI推薦模型升級係主要驅動力，Weixin生態表現亮眼
items.summary_en: Tencent Q2 marketing services revenue hit RMB 43.3B (+22% YoY), driven by AI ad recommendation upgrades and AIM+ automation within the Weixin ecosystem.
items.why: Weixin廣告效益上升，中國預算可考慮加碼
items.why_en: Weixin ad ROI rising — worth increasing China social media budget allocation.

items.title: Claude輸出全面加隱形水印
items.title_en: Anthropic Adds Invisible SynthID Watermarks to All Claude Text Outputs
items.summary: Claude輸出文字自動嵌入隱形水印，全球生效，涵蓋API及品牌內容，符合EU AI法規
items.summary_en: All Claude-generated text globally now carries invisible SynthID watermarks; applies to API outputs including brand content, in line with EU AI Act requirements.
items.why: AI代寫品牌文案可被追蹤，需留意合規風險
items.why_en: AI-generated brand copy is now traceable — review your AI content compliance approach.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash正式全面開放
items.title_en: Google Gemini 3.7 Flash Now Generally Available with Intro Pricing
items.summary: Gemini 3.7 Flash全面開放，agentic workflow能力加強，優惠定價鎖定至年底
items.summary_en: Gemini 3.7 Flash is now generally available; stronger agentic workflows and coding; introductory pricing locked to Dec 31, 2026.
items.why: 廣告自動化可升級，係年底前最低成本時機
items.why_en: Upgrade ad automation workflows at the lowest cost before the Dec 31 pricing change.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: OpenAI企業收入首次超越消費者
items.title_en: OpenAI CFO: Enterprise Revenue Surpasses Consumer Revenue for First Time
items.summary: OpenAI CFO確認企業端收入首次超越消費者端，ChatGPT企業滲透率持續加速
items.summary_en: OpenAI CFO confirmed enterprise revenue surpassed consumer for the first time, signaling rapid B2B AI tool adoption across industries.
items.why: 企業AI工具採購加速，代理公司需跟進整合
items.why_en: B2B AI adoption has crossed the tipping point — agencies should accelerate enterprise AI integration now.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: OpenAI高管接連離職IPO前夕
items.title_en: OpenAI C-Suite Exodus Raises Platform Risk Questions Ahead of IPO
items.summary: CBO、總裁、CRO相繼離職，IPO前夕管理層高度動盪，$8520億估值承壓
items.summary_en: OpenAI's CBO, President, and CRO leave in rapid succession ahead of planned IPO, raising platform stability and leadership continuity concerns.
items.why: 考慮分散AI供應商依賴，為OpenAI服務做備案
items.why_en: Vendor diversification strategy worth revisiting as key OpenAI talent continues to exit.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Google Search廣告9月強制升級AI Max
items.title_en: Google Auto-Upgrades Search Campaigns to AI Max on Sept 1 — Action Required Now
items.summary: 使用ACA或廣泛比對的廣告系列將於9月1日自動升AI Max，AI全面接管文案生成及落頁選擇
items.summary_en: Google auto-upgrades Search campaigns using ACA or broad match to AI Max on Sept 1; AI takes over ad copy and URL expansion. Claims 7% conversion lift.
items.why: 代理需即時審查客戶廣告系列，免失去文案控制
items.why_en: Agencies must audit client Search campaigns before Sept 1 or cede creative control to Google's AI.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: TikTok TopView開放自助購買
items.title_en: TikTok TopView Goes Self-Serve in 23 Markets via Ads Manager
items.summary: TikTok開屏廣告改為23個市場可在Ads Manager自助購入，Symphony AI影片代理同步推出
items.summary_en: TikTok's premium TopView placement is now self-serve in 23 markets via Ads Manager; Symphony AI Agent creates video campaigns from a brief.
items.why: 中小品牌可自助購入開屏位，入場門檻大降
items.why_en: Mid-size brands can now access TikTok's highest-impact placement without a managed-buy deal.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 可口可樂AI系統鎖定全球品牌規格
items.title_en: Coca-Cola Deploys AI-Enforced Brand Design System Across 200 Markets
items.summary: 可口可樂與Adobe合作把品牌指引轉化為AI系統，統一管理200個市場設計規格
items.summary_en: Coca-Cola's Project Fizzion with Adobe converts brand PDF guidelines into digital StyleIDs, enforcing brand consistency via AI across 200 markets.
items.why: 品牌客戶用AI鎖定規格，代理創意自由度收窄
items.why_en: AI-enforced brand guardrails are emerging — agencies will work inside machine-defined rules, not PDFs.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: JD廣告收入逆勢升12.9%
items.title_en: JD.com Q2: Ad Revenue Grows 12.9% Despite Overall Revenue Decline
items.summary: JD.com Q2整體收入跌2.9%，廣告及商業收入升12.9%至574億元，品牌廣告吸引力仍強
items.summary_en: JD.com Q2 total revenue fell 2.9% YoY but ad and marketplace revenue grew 12.9% to RMB 57.4B; JD itself cut own marketing spend 24.8%.
items.why: 京東廣告盤增長穩健，電商廣告預算可考慮加碼
items.why_en: JD ad inventory is expanding even as other spending contracts — brand budgets are holding strong.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Meta Threads廣告全球上線安全工具齊備
items.title_en: Meta Threads Ads Go Global with Full Third-Party Brand Safety Controls
items.summary: Threads廣告完成全球鋪開，新增DoubleVerify、IAS等第三方安全核查夥伴，品牌最大顧慮解除
items.summary_en: Threads ads are now globally available with DoubleVerify, IAS, Scope3, and Zefr brand safety integrations, removing the last major barrier for brand advertisers.
items.why: Threads CPM仍低，安全工具配齊，係測試良機
items.why_en: Threads CPMs are still low and brand safety is now solved — an ideal test-and-learn window.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Seedance 2.5支援30秒一次生成
items.title_en: ByteDance Seedance 2.5: 30-Second Single-Pass AI Video with 50 References
items.summary: 即夢新模型支持30秒單次生成、50個多模態參考素材及3D分鏡控制，廣告創意用途強
items.summary_en: ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 generates 30-second video in one pass, accepts up to 50 multimodal reference assets, and supports 3D camera blocking.
items.why: 品牌廣告片可一次出完整故事，省去剪接工序
items.why_en: Brands can now produce full-length ad stories in a single AI generation pass, cutting post-production time.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: Grok Imagine Image 2.0多參考圖生成
items.title_en: xAI Releases Grok Imagine Image 2.0 with Multi-Reference Editing and 2K Output
items.summary: 支持5張參考圖、區域編輯、Smart Resize及2K輸出，圖像編輯評分全球第二
items.summary_en: Grok Imagine Image 2.0 launched Aug 11 with up to 5 reference inputs, region-level editing, Smart Resize, and 2K output — ranked #2 globally on image editing benchmarks.
items.why: KV設計及產品海報可多圖參考生成，大幅減少設計迭代
items.why_en: Multi-reference image generation cuts KV and product poster iteration rounds for creative teams.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: Google AI媒體可移除可見水印
items.title_en: Google Now Allows Removing Visible Watermarks from AI-Generated Images and Video
items.summary: Gemini及Flow編輯器允許移除AI生成圖片及影片嘅可見水印，隱形C2PA元數據繼續保留
items.summary_en: Google's Gemini and Flow editor now allow removing visible watermarks from AI-generated images and video; invisible C2PA metadata stays intact for provenance.
items.why: 廣告AI素材製作更自由，同時保有追溯記錄
items.why_en: More creative freedom for AI ad assets while content provenance remains traceable.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: 小紅書AI虛擬人帳號須標明身份
items.title_en: XHS New Rule: AI Virtual Persona Accounts Must Disclose Identity — Compliance by Aug 7
items.summary: 8月7日起小紅書AI虛擬人帳號須在資料頁標明身份，主動披露不影響流量分配
items.summary_en: From Aug 7, XHS AI virtual persona accounts must display an identity label on their profile; self-disclosure does not reduce content distribution.
items.why: 品牌AI達人帳號須即時合規，否則有被限流風險
items.why_en: Brand AI persona campaigns must comply immediately to avoid content throttling on XHS.

items.summary_en: WeChat Mini Store data: brand merchants' monthly active sellers up 1.7x YoY, with brand-driven GMV growing 4.3x the platform average in 2026.
items.why: 微信社交電商潛力被低估，國際品牌應加速佈局

items.summary: Dentsu上半年APAC整體跌3.8%，印度係區內唯一增長市場，CXM業務持續收縮
